notes.title: Mana Gates - Patch 1.1
notes.notes:
Champions of Battle Waves, join us for the [b]Mana Gates Patch[/b]!

Control the Mana Gates in the middle of the arena to gain a Mana advantage over your opponent. Each lane has a Mana Gate, so strategize and react accordingly!

The first patch includes new features, faction balancing, quality of life improvements and bug fixes.

[h3]Patch Notes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New Feature: Mana Gates[/b] - Be the last team to pass through the Mana Gates in each lane to boost your Mana regen.
[*] [b]Unit Highlighting[/b] - Click on Units in the battlefield to see their Card info.
[*] [b]New Languages Available: Spanish & Portuguese[/b] - Change the language (first option) in the settings menu.
[*] Added [b]Quickplay Difficulty[/b] option in the Settings menu. Please share your feedback on Discord, we will adjust difficulty in the next patch.
[*] Removed incorrect unlock labels in Quickplay. Unlock factions via the Campaign.
[*] Balance changes for various Factions.
[*] Minor bug fixes and quality of life improvements.
[/list]
Welcome new players and new members of the CAGE community!
🕹️ Join us on Discord to play new prototypes, meet the devs, or party up with fans

Also, we're excited to announce the [b]CAGE Studios Bundle[/b]! Play all our games and show your love for an indie duo making games together for over a decade. ❤️

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48115/CAGE_Studios/

We hope you enjoy the new update and weeklong bundle discount. Thank you for playing and [b]please leave a review[/b] if you're having fun!

Sincerely,
Salaar and Gabriel
[url=https://cagestudios.net/]CAGE Studios[/url] 🔓

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
[h3]Battle Waves, an upcoming card battler with tower defense action, will release on [b]December 2, 2024[/b] for $4.99.[/h3]

[h3][b]Wishlist now[/b] to be ready for the call![/h3]

[previewyoutube=Spz5hG3FqnM;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]Battle Waves brings a fresh twist on card battlers with epic battles and strategic deckbuilding.[/h3]

Craft a deck of compatible creatures and spawn waves of minions to overpower the enemy base. Claim victory against ruthless foes in the roguelite campaign or compete against the world in online multiplayer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42295557/bf471648cbf54a5e6cebdd365c8ce7c6c3173d49.gif[/img]

[h3]When two worlds collide, an empire emerges.[/h3]

Build a team of necro-liches, mechs, forest guardians, and countless creatures to challenge fierce opponents. Destroy the enemy turrets or go straight for their base crystal. Reinforce defenses or send minions to rush a distracted foe. Explore thousands of decks and strategies to emerge victorious.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42295557/b739f61e820dd090a85ee7b951ee239d3a144aab.gif[/img]

[h3]Clash forces in jungles, volcanoes, pirate ships, and other legendary locations.[/h3]

Level up cards to spawn waves of powerful beasts. Rank up to unlock factions and operators for unique bonuses in every battle. Climb the leaderboards and claim the throne in the escalating campaign, hardcore mode, and ranked multiplayer.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1965620/Battle_Waves_Card_Tactics/
